proof.pattern: kill-switch exact join unresolved \(.*\) — rebuild requested \[change=kill-join-1107\]
kill-switch exact join resolved [0-9.]+ min after the first rebuild request .*\[change=kill-join-1107\]

expected_rate: one unresolved-join line per distinct reason after a protected-tier (QHM/F6) fill or stop, then one on-request rebuild line and one 'exact join resolved' line within about 1-2 minutes; sessions with no protected fill have none
window_reason: QHM buys or stops on most weeks (11-05 NVDA stop, 11-06 NVDA and GE buys); five sessions normally include at least one protected fill
reversal: a pause after a fill that lasts longer than two rebuild runs with no refusal logged, or any change in a replayed kill measure; also any 'Loop error' traceback through can_open_position()/check_kill_switch()

metrics.name: minutes of RTH with entries paused by an unresolved join per protected fill
metrics.source: logs/mtf_bot.log 'exact join resolved N min after the first rebuild request [change=kill-join-1107]' lines
metrics.bound: at most 2 minutes per protected fill when no refusal is logged (11-06 baseline: 46 minutes)

baseline_exempt_reason: every proof line carries [change=kill-join-1107], which is new in this change, so a match can only come from the new code
